historical_versions: retained for reproduction; excluded from active defaults
validation: shared union of frozen terminal audited prompts only
validation_tokens: additional, measured separately; never fed to optimization
reserve_reclamation: disabled: one frozen terminal full-search audit for every method
final_selection: all terminal incumbents (population cap4, audit cap4), full-search audit before held-out evaluation
candidate_evaluation: readiness warm-up then progressive common-block intensification
repeatability_probe: H200 batch-invariant structured-label protocol; no unsupported claim of cross-hardware invariance
experimental_candidate: v9.4 evidence-racing extension; v9.2 structural reproduction and v9.3 retained unchanged
initialization: one random block, then metadata-directed common evidence until unchanged fairness readiness passes
baseline_protocol: Plain CAPO initialization/variation; full search evaluations; original selectors
early_rejection: supported delete-one-block sensitivity guard, not confidence intervals
